caseName: United States ex rel. Eichenlaub v. Watkins
caseNameFull: United States ex rel. Eichenlaub v. Watkins, District Director of Immigration & Naturalization
attorneys: Charles E. Wallington for petitioner., Solicitor General Perlman, Robert S. Erdahl and Josephine H. Klein for respondent.

opinions.text: The order entered November 15, 1948, denying certiorari, 335 U. S. 867, is vacated. The petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Second Circuit is granted.
